objectives_fil: Sa halimbawang health station at field visit, tukuyin ang limang uri ng panganib at ipares ang isang nakitang panganib sa posibleng pinsala, agarang kontrol at reporting contact.
objectives_en: In a sample health-station and field-visit setting, identify five hazard groups and match one observed hazard to potential harm, immediate control and reporting contact.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ang kaligtasan sa trabaho ay nagsisimula sa pagtukoy ng hazard at lokal na requirements bago ang gawain.
sections.takeaway_en: Workplace safety starts by identifying hazards and local requirements before the task.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ang checklist ay dapat humantong sa kontrol at follow-up, hindi sa pagbilang lamang ng hazards.
sections.takeaway_en: A checklist should lead to controls and follow-up, not merely count hazards.

sections.takeaway_fil: Kumpirmahin ang hindi tiyak at gawing tiyak ang ulat bago ang gawain.
sections.takeaway_en: Confirm unknowns and make the report specific before work.

check.prompt_fil: May basang sahig sa pasukan. Aling ulat ang magagamit agad?
check.prompt_en: The entrance floor is wet. Which report supports immediate action?

options.fil: “Basang pasukan, panganib madulas; ilayo muna ang tao at ipatama sa responsableng staff.”
options.en: “Wet entrance, slip risk; keep people away and arrange correction with responsible staff.”

options.fil: “Mag-ingat na lang ang lahat hanggang uwian.”

options.en: “Nobody was hurt, so no action is needed.”

check.feedback_fil: Una: may lugar, panganib at agarang aksyon ang ulat. Ikalawa: hindi inaalis ng “mag-ingat” ang basang sahig. Ikatlo: hindi dahilan ang walang nasaktan para ipagpaliban ang aksyon. Sa adaptasyon, iniulat ni Apple ang basang pasukan at panganib ng pagkadulas, hiniling na ilayo muna ang tao at ipaayos sa responsableng staff. Kailangan niyang kumpirmahin ang reporting contact at balikan kung naayos na; hindi pa natin alam na naitama ang sahig.
check.feedback_en: First: the report gives location, risk and immediate action. Second: “be careful” does not remove the wet floor. Third: absence of injury is no reason to delay action. In the adaptation, Apple reports the wet entrance and slip risk, requests keeping people away and correction by responsible staff. She needs to confirm the reporting contact and follow up on correction; we do not yet know that the floor has been corrected.
